description: Human category-policy review. Texts are illustrative, authored scenarios, not observed bank SMS or independent test data. Linked sources support service ambiguity, not the wording or amount.

cases.name: TALABAT — purchase type missing
cases.reviewQuestion: The message does not say whether this was restaurant food, groceries, or another product. Should Masroof require more context instead of always choosing Food?

cases.name: Talabat Mart — groceries stated
cases.exampleText: Paid JOD 24.50 to Talabat Mart for grocery order.
cases.reviewQuestion: Does a grocery order stay Groceries even though it uses the same delivery brand as restaurant meals?

cases.name: Talabat — restaurant meal stated
cases.exampleText: Paid JOD 9.50 via Talabat for a restaurant meal including delivery.
cases.reviewQuestion: Should the combined meal and delivery total be Food? A single transaction cannot be split into categories by the current output contract.

cases.name: APPLE.COM/BILL — product missing
cases.reviewQuestion: Apple says this descriptor can cover apps, subscriptions, movies, and more. Can a single category be assigned without purchase details?

cases.name: Netflix — monthly renewal
cases.exampleText: Netflix monthly subscription renewed. USD 9.99 paid.
cases.reviewQuestion: Which category wins: the recurring payment form (Subscriptions) or the purpose (Entertainment)? Your choice defines a taxonomy rule, not a factual correction to Netflix.

cases.name: Orange — device paid in full
cases.exampleText: Paid JOD 150.00 to Orange eShop for a tablet, paid in full.
cases.reviewQuestion: Should buying hardware from a telecom provider be Shopping rather than Telecom?

cases.name: Orange — device installment
cases.exampleText: تم دفع قسط جهاز لوحي لدى أورنج بقيمة 15 دينار، القسط الثالث من 12.
cases.reviewQuestion: Should an explicit installment be Installments, or should the device purpose remain Shopping?

cases.name: Orange — mixed service and device bill
cases.exampleText: Paid JOD 35.00 to Orange: internet service JOD 25.00 and device installment JOD 10.00 in one payment.
cases.reviewQuestion: One payment contains two purposes. Should one category win, or should this require context/a split policy? Record the reasoning if you choose a single category.

cases.name: JETT — monthly commuting pass
cases.exampleText: JETT Amman–Irbid monthly commuting pass paid: JOD 60.00.
cases.reviewQuestion: Does a recurring bus pass belong to Transportation, Subscriptions, or Travel?

cases.name: JETT — international bus ticket
cases.exampleText: Paid JOD 30.00 to JETT for an international bus ticket for a holiday.
cases.reviewQuestion: Should an international holiday bus ticket be Travel or Transportation?

cases.name: HyperMax — electronics stated
cases.exampleText: Paid JOD 200.00 at HyperMax for a television.
cases.reviewQuestion: Should explicit non-grocery goods override the supermarket's usual Groceries category?

cases.name: HyperMax — basket contents missing
cases.reviewQuestion: Here the amount and merchant match the previous example but the product is absent. Is Groceries an acceptable merchant default, or should Masroof ask for context? Do not infer product type from the amount.

cases.name: Pharmacy — cosmetics stated
cases.exampleText: Paid JOD 20.00 at a pharmacy for lipstick and cosmetics; no medication purchased.
cases.reviewQuestion: Should cosmetics bought at a pharmacy count as Shopping or Health? This is a hypothetical unnamed pharmacy, not a sourced business claim.

cases.name: ATM — cash amount
cases.exampleText: تم سحب مبلغ 100 دينار نقداً من الصراف الآلي. الرصيد المتاح 250 دينار.
cases.reviewQuestion: Confirm the Cash Withdrawals category for the withdrawal itself. This is an illustrative completed transaction.

cases.name: ATM — separate fee
cases.exampleText: تم خصم عمولة سحب من صراف بنك آخر بقيمة دينار واحد. هذه الرسالة للعمولة فقط ولا تتضمن مبلغ السحب.
cases.reviewQuestion: Should a separately charged ATM fee be Fees even though it contains withdrawal wording?

cases.name: University tuition — installment
cases.exampleText: تم تسديد قسط الرسوم الجامعية بقيمة 200 دينار، القسط الثاني من أربعة.
cases.reviewQuestion: Which takes priority for a tuition installment: Education or Installments? This should be consistent with your device-installment choice, unless you explicitly want different rules.

cases.name: Mobile plan — monthly renewal
cases.exampleText: تم تجديد اشتراك خط الهاتف الشهري وخصم 10 دنانير من حسابك.
cases.reviewQuestion: Should a monthly phone plan be Telecom or Subscriptions? Compare your choice with Netflix and the bus pass.

cases.name: Bill-payment channel — biller missing
cases.exampleText: تم تسديد فاتورة بقيمة 25 دينار عبر إي فواتيركم. الرصيد المتاح 100 دينار.
cases.reviewQuestion: The message gives a payment channel but no biller. A utility, tuition, or telecom bill is possible. Should Masroof require context instead of automatically choosing Water and Electricity?
